rics.description: Economic Forecasts, CBO, Budget projection, outlays
rics.meaning: Congressional Budget Office baseline projection for federal outlays. Assumes current law (no policy changes). Released in CBO Budget and Economic Outlook (Jan + August updates).
rics.how_to_use: Reference for fiscal-cliff debates and long-run sustainability framing. Compare to actual outlays (aUSFOUTL) for forecast accuracy. CBO projections are typically conservative on revenue, accurate on outlays.

rics.description: Economic Forecasts, CBO, Budget projection, revenues

rics.how_to_use: CBO consistently UNDER-estimates revenue during expansions, OVER-estimates during downturns (revenue is more cyclical than they capture). Compare to aUSFEDREC.
